=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4393-4400 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The resolver step exports GH_PAT but not GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, so gh CLI calls in the retry-state persistence path authenticate without a usable token.
  WHY: Without GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN, the gh pr edit, gh issue edit, and gh api calls in _persist_resolver_retry_state_from_current_failure fail with 401, so the AUTOFIX_RESOLVER_RETRY_STATE_V1 body update and escalation flow never happen.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4431-4436 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The label precreation / ensure_label_exists path also relies on gh CLI without GH_TOKEN in the resolver step environment.
  WHY: The gh label create call runs under the same missing-token environment; even though one caller is protected by || true, it is still the same auth omission affecting the resolver’s escalation path.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:488-493 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: _pattern_matches_patch strips diff markers and cannot tell whether a pattern match came from an added line or a removed line.
  WHY: Must_contain fingerprints should only count added lines and must_not_contain fingerprints should only count removed lines, but the current matcher treats both directions the same and can auto-close unresolved tracker issues.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:507-540 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files returns True when a file entry is status "removed" regardless of fingerprint kind.
  WHY: For must_contain fingerprints, deleting the target file permanently leaves the requirement unmet, yet the drift audit marks the cluster resolved and closes the tracker issue.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: GH_TOKEN must be exported for gh CLI calls in the resolver step
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, step "Run Codex resolver, validate, stage, commit", env section at line 4396
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The env section only lists GH_PAT and RESOLVER_ESCAPE_THRESHOLD_N; no GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN export was added, yet the helper uses gh CLI commands that require GH_TOKEN.
- requirement: "The drift audit must distinguish between additions and removals when checking if a fingerprint violation is resolved — must_contain requires a + line in the patch, must_not_contain requires a - line."
  expected_change_site: scripts/drift_audit.sh, functions _pattern_matches_patch and _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The diff for scripts/drift_audit.sh only relaxes quarantined-marker gating in _recheck_cluster and fixes the tracker-issue lookup regex anchor; _pattern_matches_patch still strips all diff markers, and _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files still returns True on status == "removed" for all kinds.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4396 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "Run Codex resolver, validate, stage, commit" step sets GH_PAT but never exports GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, so gh CLI calls in the resolver persistence path authenticate without a usable token.
  WHY: gh pr edit, gh issue edit, gh api, and ensure_label_exists all require GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN; without it, the retry-state block is never persisted and escalation never happens.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:488 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _pattern_matches_patch strips leading diff markers from every line before matching, so additions and removals containing the same text are indistinguishable.
  WHY: This lets must_contain and must_not_contain fingerprints match the wrong diff direction, producing false-positive drift resolutions.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:507-509 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files returns True whenever a file entry is status "removed", regardless of fingerprint kind.
  WHY: For must_contain fingerprints, deleting the file does not satisfy the requirement, but the tracker issue is still marked resolved.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:488 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function strips diff markers (+ and -) before pattern matching, so it cannot distinguish whether a match comes from an added line or a removed line.
  WHY: For must_contain fingerprints, removing the matching line will be treated as resolution; for must_not_contain fingerprints, adding the forbidden line will be treated as resolution.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:507-508 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function returns True when status == "removed" regardless of fingerprint kind.
  WHY: When a file is deleted, the cluster is unconditionally marked resolved, even for must_contain fingerprints where the requirement is no longer satisfiable.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4396 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The step exports GH_PAT but does not export GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, and the embedded helper calls gh_retry gh pr edit, gh_retry gh issue edit, gh_retry gh api, and gh_retry gh label create which all require GH_TOKEN.
  WHY: gh CLI authenticates via GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, not GH_PAT, so every gh invocation in the retry-state persistence path fails with 401 Unauthorized.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4436 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: ensure_label_exists calls gh_retry gh label create, but the step environment only provides GH_PAT.
  WHY: That label creation fails with authentication errors; it is protected by || true, but it demonstrates the same GH_TOKEN omission that breaks the unprotected persistence calls.
- Requirement: GH_TOKEN must be exported for gh CLI calls in the resolver step
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, step "Run Codex resolver, validate, stage, commit", env section at line 4396
  Evidence of absence: The env section only lists GH_PAT and RESOLVER_ESCAPE_THRESHOLD_N. No GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN export was added. The review_conflict_resolve.sh helper uses gh CLI commands that require GH_TOKEN.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: The drift audit should distinguish between additions and removals when checking if a fingerprint violation was resolved (must_contain requires + lines, must_not_contain requires - lines)
  Expected change site: scripts/drift_audit.sh, functions _pattern_matches_patch and _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files
  Evidence of absence: The _pattern_matches_patch function strips all diff markers without checking line prefixes. No logic exists to check patch direction based on fingerprint kind. The _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files function returns True for removed files regardless of whether the fingerprint kind is must_contain.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:517-540 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When a file entry has status "removed", the function unconditionally returns True, declaring the drift cluster resolved regardless of the fingerprint kind.
  WHY: For a must_contain fingerprint, deleting the file that should contain the required pattern permanently leaves the requirement unmet, but the tracker issue is still closed or suppressed as resolved.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:488-493 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function strips all diff prefix markers (+, -, space) from the patch content before matching, so it cannot distinguish whether a pattern match comes from an addition line or a removal line.
  WHY: Must_contain is only resolved when the PR diff adds the missing pattern and must_not_contain is only resolved when the PR diff removes the forbidden pattern; stripping markers makes the audit accept the wrong direction.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4393-4400 and line ~4431-4435 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Sets GH_PAT but not GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN, and the embedded retry-state persistence path plus the label precreation block both invoke gh under the hood.
  WHY: gh authenticates via GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, not GH_PAT, so the PR-body update, label application, and escalation comment posting fail and the escape valve becomes non-functional.
- Requirement: "The drift audit must distinguish between additions and removals when checking if a fingerprint violation is resolved — must_contain requires a + line in the patch, must_not_contain requires a - line."
  Expected change site: scripts/drift_audit.sh, functions _pattern_matches_patch and _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files
  Evidence of absence: The diff for scripts/drift_audit.sh in LAST RUN DIFF only relaxes the quarantined-marker gating in _recheck_cluster and fixes the tracker-issue lookup regex anchor. _pattern_matches_patch still strips all diff markers, and _cluster_resolved_by_pr_files still returns True on status == "removed" for all kinds. No direction-aware pattern-matching helper was introduced. The gemini-code-assist review comment (entry[1] and entry[2]) raised this exact defect and suggested a _pattern_matches_kind approach, but the code was not updated.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "GH_TOKEN must be exported for gh CLI calls in the resolver step."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, env section of the "Run Codex resolver, validate, stage, commit" step
  Evidence of absence: The env block in the PR diff (and the full PR) only lists GH_PAT and RESOLVER_ESCAPE_THRESHOLD_N. No GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }} export was added. The Copilot review comments (entries[3] and [4]) specifically called out this gap. Other steps in the same workflow (e.g. "Post review-blocked comment on PR" at line ~5656) already use GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}, confirming the pattern is established elsewhere but missing here.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
